definitions.explanation: north, south, east, and west; the four cardinal directions

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}を{山|やま}に{囲|かこ}まれている。
examples.english: It is surrounded by mountains on all sides.

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}から{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いてくる。
examples.english: The wind blows from all directions.

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}を{見渡|みわた}すと{海|うみ}しか{見|み}えない。
examples.english: Looking in all directions, I can see nothing but the sea.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}は{四方|しほう}に{散|ち}らばった。
examples.english: The enemies scattered in all directions.

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}{八方|はっぽう}{手|て}を{尽|つ}くした。
{四方|しほう}に{目|め}を{配|くば}る。
examples.english: To keep an eye on everything around.

notes:
READING VARIANTS:
Also read as よも in some expressions like {四方|よも}の{海|うみ} (seas all around; the world).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {四方|しほう}{八方|はっぽう} - all directions; every which way
- {四方|しほう}を{囲|かこ}む - to surround on all sides
- {四方|しほう}{山|やま} - mountains on all sides (landlocked location)

RELATED DIRECTIONAL TERMS:
- {東西南北|とうざいなんぼく} - the four cardinal directions
- {八方|はっぽう} - eight directions; all directions
